def: properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid

occurrences.text: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
